title: Body machine construction
statement: Given Boolean-alphabet machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$, define a machine with $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P$ work tapes, where $k_V,k_I,k_P$ are their respective numbers of work tapes. Its states are indexed by a body phase—test, clear, or increment—and a state for that phase; it is the phase-host machine formed from the body phases associated with these three machines, starting in the test phase at its anchor and using the body redirects.
